changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE admin_audit_entries ADD CONSTRAINT ck_admin_audit_entries_subject_pair CHECK ((subject_type IS NULL) = (subject_id IS NULL) AND (subject_type IS NULL OR subject_type IN ('USER', 'COMPANY'))) NOT VALID, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_admin_audit_entries_related_subject_pair CHECK ((related_subject_type IS NULL) = (related_subject_id IS NULL) AND (related_subject_type IS NULL OR related_subject_type IN ('USER', 'COMPANY')) AND (related_subject_id IS NULL OR subject_id IS NOT NULL)) NOT VALID;

changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS ix_admin_audit_entries_subject ON admin_audit_entries (subject_id, occurred_at DESC) WHERE subject_id IS NOT NULL
